purpose: Non-authorizing Stage-2 requirement and evidence control baseline; later-slice behavior is not implemented here.

sources.reference: Preserve M1 EventEnvelope; use versioned successor/codec
Persistence ports/contracts; no normal Stage-2 production PostgreSQL adapter
Contract-level inbox/outbox transactional and idempotency semantics
Registered historical versions only; unknown versions reject
Pure deterministic upcasting; original bytes immutable
Narrow justified packages; no M1 reorganization
Deterministic property generators first; extra tooling only if justified
PostgreSQL N/A for normal Stage-2 implementation scope
Repair security-workflows evaluator context before protected progression
Owner S2.0 implementation authorization and AC-01…AC-15

slices.objective: Governance, scope, decisions, catalogues, version policy and structural control
Inbox/outbox, idempotency and optimistic concurrency contracts
Integration evidence and GATE-S02-01 before data-subsystem integration

requirements.statement: Maintain an atomic, source-linked Stage-2 requirement catalogue.
requirements.property: Each requirement has one stable identity and one primary owning slice.
requirements.evidence: Structural catalogue and source-reference checks

requirements.statement: Record authorized Stage-2 scope and explicit later-stage non-scope.
requirements.property: Engineering progression grants no financial or execution authority.
requirements.evidence: Scope review against approved owner decisions

requirements.statement: Assign primary evidence ownership and transitive consumers.
requirements.property: Each slice proves properties it introduces; S2.7 integrates evidence.
requirements.evidence: Evidence ownership and reference checks

requirements.statement: Map cross-slice dependencies before later-slice coding.
requirements.property: Material later consumers cannot silently redefine earlier contracts.
requirements.evidence: Dependency-map structural checks and semantic review

requirements.statement: Validate objectively decidable control structure only.
requirements.property: Structural success is not semantic, trading or lifecycle authority.
requirements.evidence: Positive and adversarial S2.0 structural tests

requirements.statement: Apply affected-scope change impact and evidence invalidation after S2.0 closure.
requirements.property: Unrelated M1, Pre-S2 and Stage-2 evidence is not reopened automatically.
requirements.evidence: Change-control contract review

requirements.statement: Add only narrowly justified contracts or persistence packages.
requirements.property: Settled M1 modules remain in place; S2-D09 governs package scope.
requirements.evidence: Package and import-boundary review

requirements.statement: Preserve repaired security-workflows evaluator context before protected progression.
requirements.property: S2-D12 does not create new candidate authority.
requirements.evidence: Pinned Pre-S2 closure and protected proof identity

requirements.statement: Register supported successor contract versions explicitly and reject unregistered versions.
requirements.property: No implicit latest, nearest or best-effort fallback; S2-D07.
requirements.evidence: Registered/unknown-version and compatibility tests

requirements.statement: Define deterministic codec selection and pure successor upcasting policy.
requirements.property: Original historical bytes remain immutable; S2-D08.
requirements.evidence: Determinism, round-trip, rejection and historical-byte evidence

requirements.statement: Define typed identifier and value-contract successors without M1 semantic mutation.
requirements.property: Domain identity is distinct from contract and persistence versions.
requirements.evidence: Identity, equality, immutability and value-invariant tests

requirements.statement: Represent rounding-policy identity without selecting business-specific rounding.
requirements.property: Decimal/currency/quantity/time semantics remain explicit; S2-D01.
requirements.evidence: Value representation and forbidden-business-policy tests

requirements.statement: Define a versioned event successor/codec while preserving M1 EventEnvelope.
requirements.property: No in-place mutation of settled M1 event semantics; S2-D02.
requirements.evidence: Compatibility, round-trip and unchanged-M1 regression evidence

requirements.statement: Define a narrow versioned command envelope without execution authority.
requirements.property: Command existence is not an order or approval; S2-D03.
requirements.evidence: Command compatibility and authority-negative tests

requirements.statement: Keep event/command, correlation/causation and idempotency identities distinct.
requirements.property: Identity fields do not inherit authority from one another.
requirements.evidence: Lineage and conflicting-idempotency negative tests

requirements.statement: Define pure generic contract-level state transitions only.
requirements.property: No OMS, broker, reconciliation, portfolio or strategy state machine; S2-D04.
requirements.evidence: Illegal, duplicate, terminal and UNKNOWN transition properties

requirements.statement: Define persistence ports and typed outcomes without a production adapter.
requirements.property: No concrete PostgreSQL adapter in normal Stage 2; S2-D05/D11.
requirements.evidence: Port/outcome contract and no-infrastructure-leakage tests

requirements.statement: Distinguish success, failure and concurrency conflict as typed outcomes.
requirements.property: Persistence success grants no business authorization.
requirements.evidence: Outcome and stale/conflict contract tests

requirements.statement: Define contract-level inbox/outbox transactional and idempotency semantics.
requirements.property: At-least-once delivery; no exactly-once assumption; S2-D06.
requirements.evidence: Duplicate, retry, crash and transaction-coupling properties

requirements.statement: Distinguish exact duplicates from conflicting idempotency-key reuse.
requirements.property: Replay and recovery cannot become approval.
requirements.evidence: Duplicate/conflict/replay adversarial tests

requirements.statement: Define optimistic-concurrency version tokens and stale-write outcomes.
requirements.property: Concurrency version is separate from schema version and domain identity.
requirements.evidence: Stale-write, lost-update, competing-transition and retry properties

requirements.statement: Integrate versioned contracts, compatibility tests and state-machine properties for GATE-S02-01.
requirements.property: Gate permits later data integration only after evidence is green.
requirements.evidence: Attributed cross-slice gate evidence, not test count alone

requirements.statement: Integrate evidence introduced and owned by each earlier slice.
requirements.property: S2-D10 starts with deterministic property generators; S2.7 is not late test repair.
requirements.evidence: Cross-slice positive, negative, property and change-impact record

horizontal_constraints.rule: Keep schema, domain, event/command, idempotency and concurrency identities distinct.
Explicitly register supported successor versions; reject unknown versions without fallback; do not change M1 EventEnvelope.
Keep original historical bytes/evidence immutable; pure upcasting yields derived views.
Contracts, persistence, replay and recovery grant no financial or execution authority.
Assume at-least-once delivery; distinguish duplicates, conflicting reuse and stale writes.
Keep codecs, upcasters and pure transitions deterministic; infrastructure stays behind ports.
Each slice owns its evidence; S2.7 integrates and challenges it.

decisions.rule: S2.0 validation covers control structure, not later runtime behavior.
Machine-check only objectively decidable structure; semantic correctness requires review or owning-slice evidence.
No new dependency without demonstrated necessity.
Requirement IDs are stable independently of owning slice.
Slice and milestone IDs are traceability metadata, not public contract semantics.
One primary owning slice; transitive evidence consumers may be multiple.
Material change invalidates affected evidence, not unrelated M1/Pre-S2 or Stage-2 evidence.
Engineering lifecycle promotion is not trading or execution authority.

version_policy.applies_to: New justified Stage-2 contract and evidence boundaries only; settled M1 EventEnvelope remains unchanged.
version_policy.supported_versions: Explicit registry owned by S2.1; no registry implementation in S2.0.
version_policy.unsupported_versions: Reject unknown/unregistered versions; never choose latest, nearest or best-effort fallback.
version_policy.codec_selection: Deterministic, explicitly version-bound codec selection is required of owning slices.
version_policy.upcasting: Pure deterministic transformation produces derived views and never rewrites original bytes or evidence.
version_policy.identity_separation: Schema version is distinct from domain identity, event/command identity, idempotency identity and persistence concurrency version.

scope.authority: Neither S2.0 completion nor GATE-S02-01 grants financial or execution authority; GATE-S02-01 permits later data-subsystem integration only.

dependencies.reason: Version identity and codec policy feed events/commands.
Pure transitions consume registered version identity.
Persistence must retain version and original-byte identity.
Events and commands consume typed identities and values.
Transitions consume typed state and identities.
Ports consume typed identities and values.
Idempotency and concurrency consume distinct identities.
Command identity and events feed idempotency and replay.
Transactions consume typed outcomes and version tokens.

primary_by_slice.S2.0: Source, catalogue, scope, structural validation and controlled handoff evidence
primary_by_slice.S2.3: Event/command compatibility, round-trip and authority-negative evidence
primary_by_slice.S2.6: Duplicate, idempotency, concurrency, replay and crash-contract evidence

evidence_policy.inheritance: Direct changes require fresh evidence; transitive consumers require targeted regression; unaffected exact bytes may inherit evidence after identity and assumption checks. Test count alone is not proof.

change_control.clarification: Attributable controlled update and affected-slice review when no material contract meaning changes.
change_control.material_change: Analyze affected requirements/contracts and dependencies; invalidate affected evidence; reopen only affected scope.
change_control.preserved_boundary: Never automatically reopen unrelated M1, Pre-S2 or frozen Model D controls.

semantic_review.review: Confirm no listed contract grants financial/execution authority; structural tests do not prove this.
Confirm no M1/Pre-S2 file or settled semantic is mutated; structural tests do not prove this.
Challenge cross-slice consumers for foreseeable redesign; structural edge completeness alone is insufficient.

handoff.boundary: S2.1 requires separate authorization; this record provides no implementation or trading authority.
